g.text: CAN FD 2 / independent bus / ESP32-C5 second native controller

g.desc: CAN FD 2 / independent bus / ESP32-C5 second native controller

g.style: fill:none; stroke:#0000C2; stroke-width:0.1524; stroke-opacity:1; stroke-linecap:round; stroke-linejoin:round;
g.text: Design assumption: both CAN ports combined <=1A total, <=40C. Separate motor power. Fuse does not block reverse feed.

g.desc: Design assumption: both CAN ports combined <=1A total, <=40C. Separate motor power. Fuse does not block reverse feed.

g.style: fill:none; stroke:#0000C2; stroke-width:0.1524; stroke-opacity:1; stroke-linecap:round; stroke-linejoin:round;
g.text: J24 +24V -> F3 -> J27.1. J27.2 returns directly to J25/POWER_0V; NT1 bonds logic GND.

g.desc: J24 +24V -> F3 -> J27.1. J27.2 returns directly to J25/POWER_0V; NT1 bonds logic GND.

g.style: fill:none; stroke:#0000C2; stroke-width:0.1524; stroke-opacity:1; stroke-linecap:round; stroke-linejoin:round;
g.text: JP2 closed: 120ohm across H/L. Endpoints only; no termination on intermediate motion extenders.

g.desc: JP2 closed: 120ohm across H/L. Endpoints only; no termination on intermediate motion extenders.

g.style: fill:none; stroke:#0000C2; stroke-width:0.1524; stroke-opacity:1; stroke-linecap:round; stroke-linejoin:round;
g.text: One source for the chain. Firmware, cable inrush, ESD, hot-plug and physical connector fit remain untested.

g.desc: One source for the chain. Firmware, cable inrush, ESD, hot-plug and physical connector fit remain untested.

g.style: fill:none; stroke:#0000C2; stroke-width:0.1524; stroke-opacity:1; stroke-linecap:round; stroke-linejoin:round;
g.text: TX=GPIO7 (J6.8), RX=GPIO8 (J6.9). SHDN/STB fixed LOW; RGB and PSRAM retained.

g.desc: TX=GPIO7 (J6.8), RX=GPIO8 (J6.9). SHDN/STB fixed LOW; RGB and PSRAM retained.

g.style: fill:none; stroke:#0000C2; stroke-width:0.1524; stroke-opacity:1; stroke-linecap:round; stroke-linejoin:round;
g.text: Independent H/L from CAN1. Shared GND / 3V3 / 24V source; no galvanic isolation.

g.desc: Independent H/L from CAN1. Shared GND / 3V3 / 24V source; no galvanic isolation.
